segments.exact:
Submitted without an explicit id field. The pipeline must produce a
slug from the memory content — either via the LLM id-gen call or the
deterministic slugify fallback — and commit the file successfully.
segments.note: One composite assertion describing the expected pipeline behavior for id-less submissions; the enumeration of fallback paths (LLM id-gen vs. slugify) serves the single claim rather than making separate moves.
